label: In every possible history, each beginningless populated past has a coinitial descent
paraphrase: OPEN analyst structural premise about the order of time, attribution deferred: in every history accessible from the selected world, every moment at which a contingent concrete individual is present and whose past has no beginning starts a strictly descending sequence of moments that runs below every earlier moment. Integer times satisfy it (checked in control 2); rational and real times satisfy it by t - n, not separately checked. In linear time it fails only where a beginningless past has uncountable coinitiality. 'Concrete' is the supplied Concrete parameter.
